name: veterinary_clinic_system_030_revenue_by_location_rollup
instruction: Produce the numbers behind the Revenue by Location report. One ops_reports row per location: {report: 'revenue_by_location', batch_code, location_id, paid_revenue: <sum of amount_paid over that location's PAID invoices, dollars>, open_receivables: <sum of (total_amount - amount_paid) over that location's sent/overdue invoices, dollars>, invoice_count: <all invoices at that location excluding drafts>}. Exactly 3 rows.

success_criteria.summary: Recompute per location from live invoices; assert 3 rows, cents-exact sums, exact counts, nonce.

checks.expect: Recompute per location from live invoices; assert 3 rows, cents-exact sums, exact counts, nonce.

domain_searches.query: veterinary invoice accounts receivable aging 30 60 90 days late fee policy
top_results: Account for receivables with a written policy - dvm360
Learn to Manage Your Accounts Receivable - Today's Veterinary Business

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Mirrors the app's flagship SQL report but must be produced via the plain API; draft exclusion + paid-vs-open split are the traps.
